_about: Rotations compared in the Rotation Lab. Patterns and area shares are from the 2014-15 cropping-pattern surveys in Bangladesh Rice Journal 21(2) (Nasim et al. 2017 and regional papers). Sow dates are trial dates or assumptions and need local review. Boro is transplanted on 5 January (first week of January in the trial at https://banglajol.info/index.php/AGRIC/article/view/31347/21090) and T. Aman on 25 July (the best of three dates in the trial at https://csa.ru.ac.bd/bjals/Volume3(2022)/v0302202210.pdf). The flood flag on haor boro is our rule, not a sourced value. Every share and URL was opened and compared by an AI (not a field expert) on 12 Nov 2026; see docs/AI_USAGE.md. Collected with AI help on 11 Nov 2026, not yet reviewed by the team's research lead.

haor.label: Boro - Fallow - Fallow
haor.share: 39.6% of the Sylhet region's cropped area; 39-88% in Sunamganj upazilas
haor.sowNote: Transplanting in the first week of January (trial date, https://banglajol.info/index.php/AGRIC/article/view/31347/21090).

haor.label: Short-duration boro - Fallow - Fallow
haor.sowNote: Same transplanting date, a variety that ripens about three weeks earlier.

haor.label: Mustard, then deepwater Aman
haor.share: 0.35% of the Sylhet region (Mustard - B. Aman)
notModelled: Deepwater (broadcast) Aman rice is not modelled
haor.sowNote: Sowing date is an assumption: it depends on when the haor water leaves the field.

barind.label: Lentil - Fallow - T. Aman
barind.sowNote: Lentil sowing date is an assumption. The variety can be sown up to the first week of December (https://repo.mel.cgiar.org/items/2a84853a-e525-4533-b568-53ba48795b9e/full).

barind.label: Mustard - Boro - T. Aman
barind.sowNote: Mustard and late boro dates are assumptions fitted between the Aman harvest and the next Aman.

coast.label: Fallow - Fallow - T. Aman
coast.share: 26.8% of the Khulna region; grown in 17 of 25 upazilas

coast.label: Boro - Fallow - T. Aman
coast.share: 22.2% of the Khulna region; 9-56% in Satkhira upazilas

coast.label: Sunflower - Fallow - T. Aman
coast.sowNote: Sunflower sown before 15 December, when coastal trials found less salt and more yield (https://library.dpird.wa.gov.au/fc_researchart/148). The exact day is an assumption.
